actions.label: Jail the player
actions.desc: Locks the streamer in a steel-barred jail cell right where they stand. They can see the store through the bars but can't grab, place or use skills until the time is up. More jail gifts add more time.

actions.label: Free the player from jail
actions.desc: Lets the streamer out of jail early. The cell disappears and they carry on where they are.

actions.label: Speed boost
actions.desc: The streamer walks and runs faster for a while.

actions.label: Super jump
actions.desc: The streamer jumps more than twice as high for a while.

actions.label: Magnet
actions.desc: Turns on the game's own Magnet skill for free: nearby products get pulled toward the streamer.

actions.label: Shelf glow
actions.desc: Turns on the game's own shelf glow skill for free: the right shelf for what the streamer is holding lights up.

actions.label: Give XP
actions.desc: Gives the streamer this much skill XP, as if they had finished shelves.

actions.label: Freeze
actions.desc: The streamer can't move for a few seconds. They can still look around.

actions.label: Slow walk
actions.desc: The streamer moves at a crawl (0.3x speed) for a while.

actions.label: Product explosion
actions.desc: Every loose item within a few metres of the streamer goes flying. Items already on shelves are never touched.

actions.label: Lights out
actions.desc: The whole store goes dark for a while.

actions.label: Launch the player
actions.desc: Throws the streamer up into the air.

actions.label: Moon gravity
actions.desc: Everything gets floaty for a while: the streamer and every falling product.

actions.label: Product rain
actions.desc: Loose items from around the store drop out of the sky onto the streamer. Shelved items are never taken.

actions.label: Dizzy camera
actions.desc: The streamer's view sways and wobbles for a while.

actions.label: Barrel roll
actions.desc: The streamer's view spins all the way around.

actions.label: Tidy items
actions.desc: Puts this many loose items onto their right shelves for the streamer, nearest first, the same way the game's Pair Up skill does. Set any amount.

actions.label: Mess up items
actions.desc: Knocks this many already-sorted items off their shelves, nearest first, so the streamer has to sort them again. Set any amount.

actions.label: Insta win
actions.desc: Sorts every loose item in the store onto its shelf.

actions.label: Insta reset
actions.desc: Starts this store over from scratch and reloads it. The save is backed up first.

actions.label: Reset (backup kept)
actions.desc: Starts this store over and keeps a backup of its save in BlumMods backups, so it can be restored later.

actions.label: Save reset
actions.desc: Wipes every store back to brand new and returns to the menu. All save files are backed up first, just in case.
